It was first published in the May 2023 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Comics]]'', released on April 14, 2023.[https://web.archive.org/web/20240205062704/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=0380905123 ''CoroCoro Comics'' May 2023 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)[https://web.archive.org/web/20230414031321/https://corocoro.jp/news/362088/ ''CoroCoro Comics'' May 2023 issue | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)[https://web.archive.org/web/20230416061330/https://corocoro.jp/news/361980/ ''CoroCoro Comics'' May 2023 issue - Pocket Monsters | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)[https://twitter.com/yamadaka_k56/status/1646777809917083649 Kei Yamadaka on Twitter] (Japanese) It is based on the {{pkmn|animated series}} episodes ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' and ''[[HZ002|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two)]]''.
